rubric.reason: Both disputed tests (figma-track-phase6.test.mjs:218-240, :417-429) were authored test-after for figma-implementation-track.prd.md (v1) Phase 6 — confirmed by the file's own header (lines 3-13: Source PRD figma-implementation-track.prd.md), predating figma-visual-first-track.prd.md (v2, approved 2026-07-24). AC-4 (figma-visual-first-track.prd.md:58) mandates, not merely permits, that the phase does not reach complete until VISUAL_VERIFIED or explicit human approval, never silently proceeding on a mismatch; Phase 5 Goal (180-183) requires Phase A.3.4 to block a visual-scoped phase. This repo's sole established vocabulary for stop-the-pipeline-pending-external-resume is the pre-existing HALT-with-verbatim-message idiom (relay-implement.md Phase A.1, mirrored explicitly by this plan's Pattern 2 and pre-approved by plan-reviewer as this same plan's own AC-A1 HALTs wording) — so test:227's block-wide ban on the literal word HALT directly contradicts AC-4's plain mandate for phase_scope:visual. It was true of v1's byte-identically-non-blocking Phase A.3.4 and is deliberately narrowed by this plan's own Decision Gate block, recorded before implementation began. Verified independently: the diff (relay-implement.md:368-429, visual-verifier.md:96-101) matches plan Tasks 3/4/5/6 near-verbatim, touches only the 4 files in Files-to-Change, and is not over-broad — a synonym swap for HALT would only fragment this file's own established internal vocabulary without being required by anything in the PRD, so no narrower conformant implementation was available. Separately, test:424-428's exact 8-field manifest-shape assertion on visual-verifier.md Step 0 is structurally incompatible with Architecture Notes (133: visual-verifier passes the Interaction column through to the frame manifest) and the Must-priority Interaction capability in the MoSCoW table — a single accurate shape-documenting sentence cannot enumerate both 8 and 9 fields simultaneously; Task 3's replacement (verified verbatim in the diff) is the only conformant implementation, consistent with this repo's own comment-accuracy convention (also applied in Task 1 for capture.mjs). Additionally and not raised in the dispute's own claim: four more of test:218-240's exact-string assertions (the VISUAL_VERIFIED, VISUAL_DEGRADED, BUDGET_EXCEEDED_REVERTED and BUDGET_EXCEEDED bullet matches) independently break due to the mandatory 5-site "(subject to the Terminal-routing rule below)" forward-reference Task 5 Part A requires at every proceed-to-A.3.5 site (verified: exactly 5 occurrences in the diff, matching the plan's own Level-3 VALIDATE count) — this corroborates that the entire cited test, not only the disputed HALT line, pins a v1 invariant this PRD deliberately supersedes for the visual-scoped case; the non-visual behavioral path remains byte-identical per the Terminal-routing paragraph's own first bullet, so AC-A2/AC-A3 are not implicated. PRD text is not ambiguous on either point, ruling out DISPUTE_UPHELD_PRD_AMBIGUOUS. Per docs/anti-patterns.md's sanctioned obsolete-test-retirement carve-out, the remedy is test-pair-authored amendment of figma-track-phase6.test.mjs (test_frameworks:[node:test] is active in this repo, test-after) — not implementation reversion and not PRD amendment.

dispute_evidence.claim: Both disputed tests were authored for Phase 6 of the PRIOR figma-implementation-track.prd.md (the test file's own header comment, lines 3-13, names that PRD as its source). The current PRD deliberately narrows the exact invariants those tests pin, for the phase_scope: visual case only. The Phase 5 plan's own Decision Gate block names this tension in advance, verbatim: "today's 'every branch proceeds to Phase A.3.5 without halting' guarantee is deliberately narrowed to non-visual-scoped plans only, per this PRD's own AC-4." (1) figma-track-phase6.test.mjs:227 asserts assert.ok(!/ HALT /.test(block)) against the ENTIRE Phase A.3.4 block. AC-4 requires the phase not reach complete until VISUAL_VERIFIED or explicit human approval, never silently proceeding on a mismatch; Task 5 implements that as two named HALT outcomes (AWAITING_VISUAL_APPROVAL, VISUAL_GATE_BLOCKED) with verbatim HALT messages inside the A.3.4 block. The block cannot both contain the PRD-mandated HALT vocabulary and zero occurrences of HALT. (2) figma-track-phase6.test.mjs:424-428 asserts visual-verifier.md Step 0 contains the exact OLD 8-field sentence ending ...ref_png, masks}. AC-4 and Architecture Notes require the Design Spec Interaction column be passed through to the frame manifest, and Task 3 REPLACES that sentence with a 9-field form ending ...ref_png, masks, interaction}. Old and new cannot coexist — Task 3 is a replacement.
dispute_evidence.proposed_resolution: Amend both assertions in figma-track-phase6.test.mjs rather than reverting the implementation or amending the PRD — (1) scope the never-HALT assertion to the non-visual-scoped case (e.g. against the Terminal-routing rule's phase_scope_value != "visual" first bullet, which this phase preserves byte-identically) rather than the whole block; (2) update the manifest-shape string from 8-field to 9-field. The Implementer argues this belongs to the test-writer/test-reviewer pair's test-after pass under docs/anti-patterns.md's sanctioned obsolete-test-retirement carve-out, not to the Implementer (R-X strict).

rubric.reason: No high or medium severity findings against business-rule consistency, bugs, or security. Low-severity advisory (non-failing): parseInteractionScript's top-level split(';') tokenizer has no escape mechanism for a literal semicolon inside a fill(...) value, and a trailing or empty semicolon-separated segment throws 'unrecognized interaction step' rather than degrading gracefully -- both are inherent limits of the bounded vocabulary's own semicolon-delimited syntax (docs/context/design-spec-template.md, Phase 1 territory), not defects introduced by this diff, and neither is exercised by the plan's own VALIDATE commands. Nested parens in selectors and a comma inside a fill value are both handled correctly (verified: greedy INTERACTION_STEP_PATTERN captures up to the final ')' of the step; fill's argsRaw.split(',') + valueParts.join(',') round-trips a comma-containing value intact).

The routing/blocking decision itself is verified correct in every traced terminal point x approval-mode combination (12/12); only the halt message's retry-exhaustion narrative is imprecise for the direct-VISUAL_DEGRADED path.
